desc: the host's game crashes in a relay room (TTYD_SYNC_BACKGROUND_AT ...:crash: it ends at once, no word, no Leave) and is opened again (the harness's relaunch, TTYD_SYNC_RESUME=1 taking the Multiplayer page's Open your room again): it hosts the same room again, with the same code, session id and the relay's ticket for its place; the guest, waiting for it all along ('Waiting for <host> to come back...', never the old 10-second end), comes back to the same seat, takes the host's world again and plays on; the same progress at the end

log_must: test: the game ends at once \(a crash: no word, no Leave\)
test: the Multiplayer page's Open your room again
net: resuming the session this game had when it closed \(its session id and the relay's ticket\)
resume: hosting again the room this game was in \(player 1, seat 1\): on
co-op: player 2 is back: seat 2 again
log_must_not: That room already has a host

log_must: co-op: the host's game is gone: waiting 120 seconds for it
wait: Waiting for Test Host to come back\.\.\.
co-op: the host's game is back after [0-9]+ ms: the wait is over
